textTemplates.name: Text_Message_Inbound_RecommendMultipleProducts
textTemplates.text:
Don't forget to recommend multiple products! 

"I know you are just interested in leads, but I think our Lead Connection Service could be a good fit for your business and I recommend asking the sales rep to tell you more about the program!"

textTemplates.name: Text_Message_Outbound_RecommendMultipleProducts
textTemplates.text:
Don't forget to recommend multiple products!

The product you recommend should be aligned with the cadence the target is assigned to.

textTemplates.name: Text_Message_PrepopulatedFields
textTemplates.text: Some fields have been automatically populated based on answers from a previous voice call on {!get_Voice_Call_Record.Previous_Voice_Call_with_BDR_Script__r.CreatedDate}, please confirm the responses before saving.

textTemplates.name: Text_Objection_NoBudget
textTemplates.text: "Where are you currently allocating your marketing budget? Leads are a great way to hit your growth goals and expand your business. Would you be willing to speak with one of our sales reps to explore where we might be able to improve your ROI?"

textTemplates.name: Text_Objection_NoStaff
textTemplates.text:
"We have some great products that can help with staffing issues, especially our Lead Connection Service or LCS. LCS is a telemarketing subscription where you buy data leads and our expert team works the leads on your behalf. When we connect with consumers we then transfer them to your office and provide a warm hand off. 


This service helps increase efficiency and saves time enabling you to work up to 3X more leads. It also helps you make the most of existing producers and reduce the need to hire additional staff. Would you be interested in learning more about our LCS program today?"

textTemplates.name: Text_Objection_SendAnEmail
textTemplates.text: "What would you like for me to include? Just a heads up- our pricing is tailored based on your agency needs and structure. I’d love to connect with you once you’ve had a chance to review the email. When would be a good date and time for a follow up?"

textTemplates.name: Text_Objection_WasteOfTime
textTemplates.text:
"I definitely understand that working leads can be a challenge. What are some of the issues you’ve faced with leads in the past? 


Our leads are some of the highest intent on the market, which translates to higher conversion rates. We also offer calls which can be a great alternative or supplement to data leads"

textTemplates.name: Text_Objection_WhatDoesEverQuoteDo
textTemplates.text:
"EverQuote is a lead vendor that specializes in generating our own, high-intent leads. 


﻿Our leads are sourced through consumers conducting an online search for insurance quotes. We display an ad that speaks to their search language then they land on our site or one of our partner sites. They are then required to fill out up to 42 points of information for an auto or home quote. Their info is then sent directly to your CRM or LMS in real-time."

textTemplates.name: Text_Objection_WorkedWithYouBefore
textTemplates.text: "Hey I know you have worked with us before, but we are constantly working to improve our products and traffic sources to provide the most high intent consumers. Along with leads, we also offer consumer initiated calls and our lead connection service, both of which help you connect with more consumers than traditional data leads. Would you like to learn more about those products?"

textTemplates.name: Text_ResourceList_CallPricing
textTemplates.text:
"Our consumer initiated calls connect you directly with high intent consumers looking for insurance. 


These calls are exclusive to your agency so there is less competition with other agents. Along with being exclusive, they tend to convert at a higher rate than internet leads and can be great for team morale since it takes the work of cold calling consumers off of their plate! 


We also recently made some updates to our inbound calls, we are investing in improved traffic sources and filtering and also will even provide a warm hand-off when we can! Would you be interested in learning more about our available call options?"


CIC 1-pager for agents

textTemplates.name: Text_ResourceList_LCSInfo
textTemplates.text:
"LCS is a telemarketing subscription where you buy data leads and pay a monthly subscription fee for our expert team to work the leads on your behalf. When we connect with consumers we then transfer them to your office and provide a warm hand off. 


This service helps increase efficiency and saves time enabling you to work up to 3X more leads. It also helps you make the most of existing producers and reduce the need to hire additional staff. Would you be interested in learning more about our LCS program today?"

textTemplates.text:
"Our list pricing for leads starts at $6 for unfiltered leads and goes up to $23 before any discounts. Pricing can vary depending on geography, settings and lead types, would you be interested in speaking with one of our sales reps to learn more about your options?"

textTemplates.name: Text_ResourceList_ReturnsPolicy
textTemplates.text:
"Everquote’s return policy allows for you to return up to 20% of your leads each calendar month, no questions asked. We use an automated system so as long as you are below the 20% threshold, all your returns will be accepted.


You also have 30 days after the initial purchase of a lead to submit it for return."

textTemplates.name: Text_ResourceList_StateFarmScoreCard
textTemplates.text: "Are you familiar with State Farm’s lead vendor scorecard? According to their data we are the highest converting lead vendor on the market and we are constantly reviewing and updating our quality and traffic to maintain that performance for State Farm agents."

textTemplates.name: Text_Script_Inbound_Intro
textTemplates.text: Thank you for calling EverQuote, this is {!$User.FirstName} {!$User.LastName}. How may I help you?

textTemplates.name: Text_Script_Inbound_TransferRequest
textTemplates.text: I think we have products and programs that will be a good fit for your business. Would you like to get connected with a sales rep to discuss options further?

textTemplates.name: Text_Script_Outbound_Intro
textTemplates.text: Hi, this is {!$User.FirstName} {!$User.LastName} with EverQuote on a recorded line. I was calling to see if {!Formula_CallerName} or perhaps your office manager, might be available?

textTemplates.name: Text_Script_Outbound_LeaveAVoicemail
textTemplates.text:
Hi, this is {!$User.FirstName} {!$User.LastName} with EverQuote.
We are the leading business growth partner in the insurance space and offer a variety of products that can help you reach your agency goals including data leads, calls, and telemarketing services.
I wanted to check in with you to see if we could help with your business planning. If you’d like further information on what we are offering to help agents write more business you can reach me at {!$User.Phone} or book some time with me on the email I’ve just sent over.
– Have a good day!

textTemplates.name: Text_Script_Outbound_TransferRequest
textTemplates.text: Thanks for answering those questions for me. I think we have products and programs that will be a good fit for your business. Would you like to get connected with a sales rep to discuss options further?
